BrochureContent.Content:
Modern 1-Bedroom Twin Apartment 

Welcome to this brand new first letting of these apartments in Dublin 8!

This stunning 1-bedroom apartment offers the perfect blend of contemporary design and comfort.

Step inside to discover a spacious open-plan layout, featuring a stylish kitchen seamlessly flowing into a dining area and living space. Perfect for entertaining guests or enjoying quiet evenings in, the layout is designed for both functionality and elegance.

Relish the convenience of your very own balcony, where you can soak in the sights and sounds of the vibrant city around you. Whether it's sipping your morning coffee or unwinding at sunset, this private outdoor space is yours to enjoy.

The generously sized bedroom is a sanctuary of relaxation, boasting fitted wardrobes and shelving units for ample storage. Wake up refreshed and ready to take on the day in this tranquil haven.

Filled with natural light and modern finishes throughout, this apartment offers a truly inviting atmosphere you'll love coming home to.

Don't miss out on the opportunity to make this stunning apartment your own. Contact us today to schedule a viewing and experience Dublin 8 living at its finest!

**Please note: 
1) There are multiple property types available in this development. The photos shown here may not be of the actual unit available but represent the standard of finish. 
2) The rent advertised on the individual property ads represent the starting rent for these property types. Rents will vary throughout the development depending on the specific property type. Not all the available properties and rents are listed here; please use those available at viewings. 
3) The overall BER Rating on this development is A Rated, an individual BER cert for your specific apartment is available on move in, upon request. 
4) Amenities are subject to different opening times than apartment move in dates and are tied in with overall development time frame and may be subject to change.
